descriptionByLocale.it:
Sulzer is a leading engineering company with a proud heritage of innovation. Join our global team to grow your expertise and develop innovative solutions that enable a prosperous and more sustainable society. About the role Job Summary Responsible for planning, coordinating, and organizing the die buy-off process. They also evaluate tooling trial and developmental trials for sign off. Responsibilities
• Coordinates with management, project managers and the sales department to review job scopes (active, inactive, or "to be quoted") to ensure the correct Equipment, Tooling and Supplies will be available
• Scheduling the delivery of Equipment, Tooling and supplies to Jobsites.
• Interfaces with vendors and other divisions within Sulzer, to ensure maximum effectiveness and cooperation completing tasks assigned to the tool crib.
• Research and purchase new tooling and tooling improvements for the Field Service Division.
• Handle all Inspections, licensing and repairs on equipment in the Field Service Tool Crib.
• Document and track all missing and broken tooling and create database to associate it with the jobs and supervisors
• Coordinates with the Project Manager and the Field service Supervisor to supply additional tooling and supplies during the project execution phase Qualifications: The i d eal ca nd i d ate will p o sse s s t h e f o l l o win g :
• High School Diploma or Equivalent
• Mechanical aptitude is a plus
• Tool Coordinator experience preferred
• Work overtime when required What we offer you
• 12 Paid Holidays
• 15 Paid Time Off (PTO) Days
• Medical, dental, vision, life & disability
• 401K with 6% company match
• Employee Assistance Program
• Employee Wellness Program
• New onsite cafeteria, all meals subsidized (La Porte Service Center) Sulzer is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in the strength of a diverse workforce and are committed to offering an inclusive work environment. We are proud to be recognized as a Top Employer 2026 in Brazil, Canada, China, Finland, Germany, Ireland, Mexico, Switzerland, South Africa, the UK and the USA.
